body: Reproduced on nightly. Adding high-pri for the crash. Should be an easy fix to guard against empty inputs.
Regarding the deprecation warning, we do discourage use of `reduce` and `size_average`. You should prefer using `reduction` instead.

I think the main problem here is that `input1` and `input2` are of different shapes, which is not allowed according to the [docs](https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.CosineEmbeddingLoss.html) but is never checked in the code. I will prepare a PR to fix this.

issue.title: Enforce both input tensor shapes of CosineEmbeddingLoss to be equal.
